result.summary: Fix applied to src/event_store/store.zig. Removed nested pool.acquire() (was 3 lines: const dup_conn = self.pool.acquire() ... ; defer self.pool.release(dup_conn); ). Renamed both duplicate-lookup queries from dup_conn.query(...) to conn.query(...) — reusing the held, rolled-back conn for the events-table SELECT and the events_archive SELECT. zig build exit 0, error-set grep empty. zig build test-integration-exp exit 0 — TC-EXP-202 (Create record idempotency) is part of this suite and exercises the exact fixed path (two createRecord calls with the same idempotency_key, second call asserts r2.is_duplicate=true). StoreError.PoolExhausted now reachable only at the 6 legitimate single-acquire sites (lines 277, 559, 666, 724, 895, 955). Commit 8f3b9c1d pushed to feature/WF03-GH521-20260808. No migration required (fix is code-only).
